title: Get ns8-qbittorrent settings
description: Current settings of the qBittorrent instance

host.title: Host name
host.description: Host name for the WebUI, like 'qbittorrent.domain.org'. Empty when the module is not configured yet.

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: A valid Let's Encrypt certificate is requested.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: All the HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS

downloads_dir.title: Downloads directory
downloads_dir.description: Custom host path bind-mounted as the downloads directory. Empty when the qbittorrent-downloads named volume is used.

bt_port.title: BitTorrent listen port
bt_port.description: TCP/UDP port used for incoming peer connections.

bt_port_enabled.title: Open the BitTorrent port in the firewall
bt_port_enabled.description: Incoming peer connections are allowed from the public firewall zone.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone used inside the container.

auth_whitelist.title: Trusted networks
auth_whitelist.description: Subnets whose clients reach the WebUI without a password. Empty when authentication is always required.
